'''''Tessera''''' was one of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Imperial-class, Jerec)|''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[0 ABY/Legends|Nine months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], accompanied by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Wolver]] and [[Tier]], took the shuttle to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[S'krrr]] to study [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] art. After both Wolver and Tier were killed by swarms of [[drog]] beetles, Thrawn, together with the S'krrr poet and warrior [[Sh'shak]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] children [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], fled to the ''Tessera'' in an attempt to escape the [[Sikadian Garden]]s. However, beetles had gotten into the ship's system, causing them to short-circuit and leaving both the engines and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] offline. As beetles started to pour in through the ship's air vents, the group were forced to abandon it. Later, when Sh'shak and [[Mammon Hoole]] were able to temporarily calm the swarm, Thrawn returned to the ''Tessera'' to attempt repairs.
